item.title: Version 1.3.6
item.description:
Surge Browser 1.3.6

Fewer interruptions, and translation that knows what it's reading.

  • No more stray "Verify it's you". A sign-in token problem can no longer show a Google verification prompt. Your Surge sign-in stays put.
  • Translation reads the page. Surge now detects a page's language even when the page doesn't say what language it's in, so more pages get the offer to translate.
